newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain -Corn basis remains lower, soy flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain -Corn basis remains lower, soy flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values slipped one cent a bushel and soybeans steadied, export sources said.
Soft red winter wheat offers dropped five cents while hard red winter wheat values were higher.
"The wheat market is dead," one U.S. export source said.
He noted mills appeared to have backed off their buying interest in soft wheat. "There is also a lack of export demand," he said.
In export news, a group of South Korean feed milling companies bought 52,500 tonnes of corn on Tuesday.
But they passed on a tender for another 52,500 tonnes, an official at one of the companies said.
Pakistan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat, the country's shipping agent said.
The Taiwan Flour Mills Association bought two shipments totalling 61,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat at tender on Tuesday, Taipei traders said.
